credits.title: Avaraachan & Sons
credits.overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

credits.title: Painkili
credits.overview: Tale of Suku, who fakes insanity to escape the law. While faking insanity, he falls in love.

credits.title: Aavesham
credits.overview: Three college freshmen in Bangalore befriend an eccentric gangster to get revenge on their senior bullies.

credits.title: RDX: Robert Dony Xavier
credits.overview: Once-menacing, anger fueled, trained martial arts fighters Robert, Dony and Xavier settle down to peaceful lives, after a significant event prompts them. Fate orchestrates their reunion and return from exile to their fighting ways, when their history linger ominously and one of them faces a violent attack.

credits.title: Romancham
credits.overview: Set in 2007, in the outskirts of Bengaluru, A game of Ouija board goes hilariously wrong when seven bachelors unexpectedly invite a spirit and try to make the best out of the situation.

credits.title: Maheshinte Prathikaaram
credits.overview: Mahesh, a studio photographer and owner of the studio. As the story moves on, Mahesh encounters an anonymous fight ending up with taking revenge that leads to certain realizations in his life.
